author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.50 shipped: Rooms never pick up device-settings switches
summary: Rooms never pick up device-settings switches
why: Bulk room create at Wigton put every mmWave anti_interference switch and URA's own coordinator switches into room switch lists, and URA toggled them with occupancy; measured that Sonoff detach / Z2M anti_interference carry no entity_category, so the filter needs a whole-word name backstop on top of the category rule, applied at the one prefill choke point and at all four actuation sites.
implications: Shipped ROOM-CREATE-AREA-PREFILL-DETRITUS-1 at v5.103.50; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.50.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a real load is ever refused (a relay named with one of the tokens), or a new settings-switch family appears in a room config.

refs.release_notes: Room creation no longer prefills URA's own or device-settings switches (detach, anti-interference, indicator, do-not-disturb, child-lock, config/diagnostic); a runtime guard never actuates them even if already stored; a boot scan warns about leftovers.
